Central Government employees whose selection for appointment was finalized before 1-1-2004 after being declared successful for recruitment in the results declared on or before 31-12-2003 against vacancies occurring on or before 31-12-2003 will be covered under CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972, subject to exercising of option before 31-5-2020. - OM, dated 17-2-2020.
